products.name: Crescent Rose
products.short: Three forms. One prop. Animated Scythe, Gun and compact Pack modes for your PCVR avatar.
products.long: A transforming VRChat avatar prop with connected mechanical animations, lower-back storage and right-hand deployment. Includes VRCFury integration, mode icons, a visibility toggle and setup instructions. Requires a compatible humanoid avatar, VRChat SDK and VRCFury installed separately. Fit the pack and hand alignment to your avatar in Unity. Personal avatar use only; no redistribution or resale. Avatar not included.
specs: PCVR / Windows only — no standalone Quest or Android

products.name: Predator Nanomask
products.short: Necklace to nanomask. Four vision modes and twenty rigged dreads for your PCVR avatar.
products.long: A deployable nanotech mask for VRChat avatars that transforms out of a necklace, with twenty rigged dread strands, a particle transfer effect and four wearer-only vision modes (Clear, Thermal, UV, Wireframe) plus a persistent HUD. Includes VRCFury integration, custom expression-menu icons and full fitting/installation tools. Requires a compatible humanoid avatar, VRChat SDK and VRCFury installed separately. Personal avatar use only; no redistribution or resale. Avatar not included.

products.name: Metal Boots
products.short: Heavy black combat boots with purple accents, loose-lace PhysBones and RGB lace color controls for your PCVR avatar.
products.long: A heavy, detailed pair of black PCVR boots with purple accents, visible stitching, embossed KuroLabs marks and readable kurolabs.net rear straps. Includes a Unity humanoid fitting tool, VRCFury armature links, two branched lace PhysBones with fitted leg colliders, and saved RGB controls for changing the lace colour in VRChat. Requires a compatible humanoid avatar, VRChat SDK and VRCFury installed separately. Avatar proportions differ, so calf width, trousers, covered feet and clipping should still be checked on your own avatar. Personal avatar use only; no redistribution or resale. Avatar not included.

products.name: Harbinger
products.short: Five forms. One weapon. Animated Sword, Extended Sword, Gun, Scythe and Packed modes for your PCVR avatar.
products.long: Harbinger is a transforming VRChat weapon with five forms: Sword, Extended Sword, Gun, Scythe and Packed. Featuring animated transformations, moving cogwheels, a katana-style wrapped handle and an extending red scythe edge. Includes an easy avatar installer and installation guide, custom menu icons with separate transformation controls, hand and back placement with adjustable fitting and overall size, Show/Hide, World Lock and Flip Grip, and left-hand click-to-reposition along the deployed scythe handle. Gun mode includes the transformation; firing effects are not included. Requires your own humanoid avatar, VRChat Avatars SDK, VRCFury and Poiyomi Toon 9.3 (not included). Quest headsets can use it through a PC connection; standalone Quest/Android is not supported. Personal avatar use only; modification for your own avatars is allowed. No redistribution, sharing, resale or inclusion in avatars offered for sale.

Sword / Extended Sword / Gun / Scythe / Packed
Show/Hide, World Lock, Flip Grip, hand/back placement, adjustable size

products.name: Seraph Wings
products.short: Six articulated wings with living movement, poses, colour control and watchful eyes for your PCVR avatar.
products.long: Seraph Wings gives your avatar six enormous articulated wings with textured feathers, silver framing, gold accents and six watchful eyes. The wings move on their own — idle motion with occasional casual gestures, directional banking, jumping and airborne transitions, plus takeoff, hovering and landing responses for avatars running GoGoLoco. Staged Reveal and Dismiss sequences open and close them. Pose them yourself with Compact, Resting, Fully Spread, Sleep and Protective Wrap presets, left and right display poses, and manual fold/spread, lift/lower and forward/back controls for each pair; the upper, middle and lower pairs can be shown or hidden individually. Colours are fully adjustable: separate RGB and hue for feathers, frame, trim and irises, brightness and iris glow, Angelic, Fallen, Lunar and Solar presets, and adjustable rainbow modes for wings, eyes or both. The eyes gaze and blink automatically, and a focus joystick aims all of them together — shared-direction aiming, not tracking of people or world targets. Reset Pose and Reset Colors return everything to the default white, silver and gold. Includes a configured Unity prefab, rigged meshes, materials, textures, animations, organized expression menus with 54 custom icons, an editor setup and fitting tool, and both a quickstart and a detailed offline installation guide. Avatar, body, clothing and Blender source file are not included. This is a substantial accessory: expect a Very Poor performance rank, and check your avatar's upload headroom before buying — the wings added roughly 166.78 MiB of uncompressed build data in our measured test, which is separate from the ~27.8 MiB compressed download.
